title: Fixed High Hopper Treadle and Open Trough Feeder
description: One complete newly authored static agricultural dry-feed display assembly. A tall rectangular storage hopper has full thick walls and a genuinely inclined internal bottom descending to a low front throat above a separate shallow receiving channel. One full raised trough cover is held in a fixed open pose above that channel. A wide low front tread plate, two complete long side levers, two side rising rods and visible fixed pivots connect around the hopper to the cover, all carried by a whole low rail-and-foot frame. Unlike the circular foot-pedal waste bin, the low front feed channel and high rear storage volume are distinct; unlike the bell poultry drinker there is no radial reservoir/tray. No copied old mesh parts or changed bucket count. One static model, zero scenes; empty. No working pedal, validated linkage travel, actual dispensing, pest exclusion, animal suitability, hygiene, food safety, load or manufacturing claim.
